name: jev-reflection
description: Uses TypeSafe Jev to trigger focused course and wait-justification reflection.

interface.longDescription: Every five minutes during an active tool-using turn, TypeSafe Jev checks whether the work is drifting, overengineered, looping, or waiting past its evidence-backed expectation. A strong signal makes the agent visibly reflect on the named concern before continuing.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain when Jev Reflection intervenes and what the agent must reflect on.
